series.name: Residential split inverter service-manual E-codes (AR/AC types sold in PK)
series.notes: Samsung split/cassette service manuals (AC026MNJDKH, AC052MNADKH, AM072BXV, HCADKH, etc.) self-diagnostic E-code tables. High confidence (official manuals). E-codes; C121 ≠ E121 kept unmerged.

title.en: Indoor cannot receive data from outdoor
title.ur: Kamre wale unit ko bahar wale unit se data nahi milta

meaning.en: Indoor unit communication timeout — no data from the outdoor unit (initial tracking or link failure).
meaning.ur: Kamre wale unit ka communication timeout — bahar wale unit se koi data nahi aata (initial tracking ya link kharabi).

causes.en: Inter-unit communication cable loose, open or miswired
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan communication cable khuli, khoyi ya ghalat wiring lagi ho

causes.en: Outdoor PCB not powered or not responding
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB power nahi par raha ya jawab nahi de raha

solutions.en: Isolate power 20–30 min, check link wiring at both ends, restore power
solutions.ur: Power 20–30 minute ke liye band karein, dono saron link wiring check karein aur power wapas laayein

solutions.en: If code returns, technician tests outdoor board / indoor board
solutions.ur: Code wapas aaye to technician kamre wale unit aur outside unit ka board test kare

source.title: Samsung AC052MNADKH/EU service manual LED display

notes.en: Wired remotes show numeric '101'. Same fault as C101 on R-32 WindFree.
notes.ur: Wired remote par '101' number mein nazar aata hai. R-32 WindFree par C101 se yahi fault hai.

title.ur: Bahar wala unit kamre wale unit se communicate nahi kar sakta

meaning.en: Outdoor unit reports abnormal/no data from indoor (reverse link or >60 bad packets).
meaning.ur: Bahar wale unit ko kamre wale unit se abnormal ya koi data nahi milta (ulta link ya 60 se zyada kharab packets).

causes.en: Communication wire damage or noise on the link
causes.ur: Communication wire kharab ya link par noayz

causes.en: Indoor main PCB not transmitting
causes.ur: Indoor main PCB transmit nahi kar raha

solutions.en: Power-cycle both units and re-check interconnect
solutions.ur: Dono units ka power cycle karein aur interconnect dobara check karein

solutions.en: Technician isolates indoor vs outdoor board fault
solutions.ur: Technician kamre wale unit ya outside unit ke board ki kharabi alag kare

source.title: Samsung AC200KNHPKH service manual E102 section

title.ur: Ek hi communication address ki duplication ho gayi

meaning.en: Two indoor units share the same communication address on the system.
meaning.ur: System par do indoor units ek hi communication address share karte hain

causes.en: Address DIP/setting repeated after installing another head
causes.ur: Doosra head lagane ke baad address DIP/setting repeat ho gayi

causes.en: Auto-addressing not re-run
causes.ur: Auto-addressing dobara nahi chalayi gayi

solutions.en: Change the duplicate indoor address and reset the system
solutions.ur: Duplicate indoor address badlein aur system ko reset karein

solutions.en: Re-run installation addressing per manual
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq installation addressing dobara chalayein

source.title: Samsung AC026MNJDKH service manual outdoor table

notes.en: Single-split PK units rarely hit this; multi/head systems do.
notes.ur: PK ki single-split units par yeh bahut kam aata hai; multi/head systems mein aata hai.

meaning.en: Room (indoor) temperature thermistor open or short.
meaning.ur: Room (indoor) temperature thermistor khula ya short.

causes.en: Sensor failure or rat-damaged sensor wire
causes.ur: Sensor kharab ya chuhe ne sensor ki wire kaat di

causes.en: Loose connector on indoor PCB
causes.ur: Indoor PCB par connector dhila

solutions.en: Inspect/repair harness; measure and replace sensor if open/short
solutions.ur: Harness dekhein aur theek karein; sensor ko naap kar khula/short ho to badlein

solutions.en: If sensor OK, technician checks indoor PCB input
solutions.ur: Sensor theek ho to technician indoor PCB ka input check kare

notes.en: On R-32 WindFree C-series, C121 is documented by SplitAtlas as dust sensor — do not blindly merge E121 and C121 across generations.
notes.ur: R-32 WindFree C-series par SplitAtlas C121 ko dust sensor batata hai — alag generations ke E121 aur C121 ko aapas mein merge na karein.

title.en: Indoor evaporator-in (EVA IN / mid) sensor open/short
title.ur: Indoor evaporator (EVA IN / mid) sensor ka open/short

meaning.en: Evaporator inlet/mid pipe temperature sensor open or short.
meaning.ur: Evaporator inlet/mid pipe temperature sensor khula ya short.

causes.en: Sensor detached from coil or failed
causes.ur: Sensor coil se alag ho gaya ya kharab

causes.en: Rat-damaged sensor lead or loose PCB connector
causes.ur: Chuhe ne sensor ki lead kaat di ya PCB connector dhila

solutions.en: Reconnect/repair lead; replace sensor if resistance is out of range
solutions.ur: Lead dobara jori ya theek karein; resistance range se bahar ho to sensor badlein

solutions.en: If sensor measures OK, suspect indoor PCB
solutions.ur: Sensor ka measurement theek aaye to indoor PCB par shak karein

notes.en: PK/Hindi technician video (RAZA REFRIGERATION) walks exactly this cause/solution ladder.
notes.ur: PK/Hindi technician video (RAZA REFRIGERATION) mein bilkul yahi cause/solution ka tarteeb bataya gaya hai.

meaning.en: Evaporator outlet pipe temperature sensor open or short.
meaning.ur: Evaporator outlet pipe temperature sensor khula ya short.

causes.en: EVA OUT sensor failure or detached mounting
causes.ur: EVA OUT sensor kharab ya mounting se alag ho gaya

causes.en: Harness damage between coil and PCB
causes.ur: Coil aur PCB ke darmiyan harness kharab

solutions.en: Refit sensor on coil exit line; replace if open/short
solutions.ur: Sensor ko coil ki nikalne wali line par dobara lagayein; khula/short ho to badlein

solutions.en: Verify connector polarity/seating at PCB
solutions.ur: PCB par connector ki polarity aur fitting check karein

meaning.en: The evaporator-in sensor has physically come off its mounting point.
meaning.ur: Evaporator-in sensor apni mounting jagah se nikal gaya hai

causes.en: Sensor fell out of coil clip during service/vibration
causes.ur: Service ya kaanp ke dauran sensor coil se gir gaya

causes.en: Clip broken
causes.ur: Clip toot gaya

solutions.en: Reseat sensor firmly on the evaporator pipe
solutions.ur: Sensor ko evaporator pipe par mazbooti se dobara baithayein

solutions.en: Replace clip/sensor if it keeps detaching
solutions.ur: Clip/sensor baar baar alag hota ho to badlein

meaning.en: Evaporator-out sensor has come off its mounting point.
meaning.ur: Evaporator-out sensor apni mounting jagah se nikal gaya hai.

causes.en: Sensor not clipped to pipe exit
causes.ur: Sensor pipe ke exit par clip nahi hai

causes.en: Mounting clip damage
causes.ur: Mounting clip kharab ho gayi

solutions.en: Refit sensor at pipe outlet
solutions.ur: Sensor ko pipe ke outlet par dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Replace sensor assembly if clip is broken
solutions.ur: Clip tooti ho to sensor assembly badlein

title.en: Both indoor EVA-in and EVA-out sensors detached
title.ur: Indoor ke EVA-in aur EVA-out dono sensors alag ho gaye

meaning.en: Both evaporator sensors are off their mounting points.
meaning.ur: Dono evaporator sensors apni mounting jagah se hat gaye hain.

causes.en: Both clips released (panel/service work)
causes.ur: Dono clips khul gaye (panel ya service ka kaam)

causes.en: Sensor harness pulled out together
causes.ur: Sensor harness ek sath kheench kar nikal gaya

solutions.en: Refit both sensors and secure clips
solutions.ur: Dono sensors dobara fit karein aur clips mazboot kar dein

solutions.en: Verify readings before releasing unit
solutions.ur: Unit waapas dene se pehle readings check karein

source.title: Samsung split service-manual indoor sensor table (FJM/split mirrors)

notes.en: Present in FJM indoor table; less common on single splits.
notes.ur: FJM indoor table mein maujood hai; single splits par kam milta hai.

meaning.en: Indoor float/drain safety switch operated again — condensate overflow risk.
meaning.ur: Indoor float/drain safety switch dobara chala — condensate overflow ka khatra.

causes.en: Blocked or kinked drain hose / pump not pumping
causes.ur: Drain hose mori hui ya band hai / pump paani nahi nikal raha

causes.en: Dirty drain pan or float stuck
causes.ur: Drain pan ganda ya float phans gaya

solutions.en: Power off; clear drain line and pan; verify pump operation
solutions.ur: Power band kare; drain line aur pan ki safai kare; pump ka kaam verify kare

solutions.en: If water present, stop unit and call service (leak/overflow risk)
solutions.ur: pany ho to yont bnd kar ke sros blayy

source.title: Samsung AC026MNJDKH service manual outdoor table

notes.en: Wired remote shows '153'.
notes.ur: Wired remote par '153' nazar aata hai.

meaning.en: Indoor fan motor speed feedback missing / fan not running as commanded.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor ki speed feedback nahi aa rahi / fan command ke mutabiq nahi chal raha.

causes.en: Indoor BLDC fan motor failed or jammed
causes.ur: Indoor BLDC fan motor kharab ya jam ho gaya

causes.en: Hall/feedback wiring fault or indoor PCB driver fault
causes.ur: Hall/feedback wiring kharabi ya indoor PCB driver kharabi

solutions.en: Check blade freedom, filters and motor connector; restart once
solutions.ur: Fan ki blade, filters aur motor connector check karein; ek baar restart karein

solutions.en: Replace fan motor or repair PCB if fault constant
solutions.ur: Kharabi bar qarar rahe to fan motor badlein ya PCB ki marammat karein

notes.en: Same numeric slot as consumer 'E1 54' loop. Intermittent form often voltage-protection related per field notes.
notes.ur: Yeh consumer 'E1 54' loop wali hi numeric slot hai. Field notes ke mutabiq iska intermittent form aksar voltage-protection se jura hota hai.

title.ur: Mixed operation mode / chalne se pehle ki pabandi

meaning.en: Indoor requests conflict (e.g., another zone/heating-ready state while cooling start attempted).
meaning.ur: Indoor ki requests aapas mein takra rahi hain (misal ke taur par, koi doosra zone ya heating-ready halat, jab cooling start karne ki koshish ho).

causes.en: Simultaneous cool/heat demand in multi systems
causes.ur: Multi systems mein ek hi waqt cooling aur heating ki demand

causes.en: Outdoor not ready for the requested mode
causes.ur: Outdoor unit maangi gayi mode ke liye tayyar nahi

solutions.en: Power off the indoor units at the breaker first, then check the mode and setpoint on every remote/controller in the system - all of them must ask for the same mode.
solutions.ur: Sabse pehle breaker se indoor units ka power band karein, uske baad system ke har remote/controller ka mode aur setpoint check karein - sab ka mode ek hi hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Restore power and try cooling again; if the code returns, make sure the outdoor unit is not in heating-ready or defrost state and no zone is demanding heat at the same time.
solutions.ur: Power wapas on karein aur dobara cooling try karein; code wapas aaye to confirm karein ke outdoor unit heating-ready ya defrost state mein nahi hai aur koi zone sath mein heat demand nahi kar raha.

solutions.en: If the conflict stays, have the technician review the capacity/mode configuration on both boards and correct the zone settings.
solutions.ur: Agar yeh conflict barqarar rahe to technician se dono boards ki capacity/mode configuration check karwa kar zone settings theek karwayein.

source.title: Samsung AM072BXV series service manual error page

notes.en: Adjacent code E142 on some C-series tables = mixed heat+cool demand.
notes.ur: Kuch C-series tables par agla code E142 = heat+cool ka mila hua demand hai.

meaning.en: Indoor main board memory read/write failure.
meaning.ur: Indoor main board ki memory ka read/write fail ho gaya.

causes.en: Corrupted EEPROM chip/data
causes.ur: EEPROM chip/data kharab

causes.en: Board power issues during write
causes.ur: Write ke doran board ki power ke masle

solutions.en: Power-cycle; technician rewrites options or replaces EEPROM/board
solutions.ur: Power cycle karein; technician options wapas likhe ya EEPROM/board badlein

solutions.en: Authorized service for board-level repair
solutions.ur: Board level ki marammat ke liye authorized service

notes.en: Distinct from consumer E1-63 option-data wording but same subsystem.
notes.ur: Consumer E1-63 option-data wali wording se alag hai magar subsystem wahi hai.

title.en: Option code not set / option error
title.ur: Option code set nahi / option kharab

meaning.en: Model option code missing or invalid on the indoor board.
meaning.ur: Indoor board par model ka option code mojood nahi ya invalid hai.

causes.en: Option DIP/menus left at default after PCB swap
causes.ur: PCB badalne ke baad option DIP/menus default par reh gaye

causes.en: Wrong option code entered
causes.ur: Ghalat option code daal diya gaya

solutions.en: Enter correct option code per nameplate/indoor type
solutions.ur: Nameplate/indoor type ke mutabiq sahi option code daalein

solutions.en: All indoor LEDs flashing together often flags this on non-display units
solutions.ur: Bina display wali units par saare indoor LED saath mein jalte hue aksar yeh error nazar aata hai

notes.en: Primax (technician) table also lists E163 OPTION ERROR.
notes.ur: Primax (technician) table E163 OPTION ERROR ko bhi list karti hai.

meaning.en: Thermal fuse on the indoor terminal block opened due to over-temperature.
meaning.ur: Indoor terminal block ka thermal fuse zyada temperature ki wajah se khul gaya.

causes.en: Overheating at terminal block / poor connection
causes.ur: Terminal block par zyada garmi ya kamzor connection

causes.en: Restricted airflow causing coil over-temp
causes.ur: hoa km hone se koayl ki zyadh hrart

solutions.en: Do NOT bypass; power off and have technician find the heat source
solutions.ur: Fuse ko bypass mat karein; power band karein aur technician heat ki wajah dhoonde

solutions.en: Replace thermal fuse only after root cause fixed
solutions.ur: Asli wajah theek hone ke baad hi thermal fuse badlein

source.title: Samsung AC026MNJDKH service manual outdoor/indoor table

notes.en: Field notes treat as always-pro due to 230V terminal heat risk.
notes.ur: Field notes mein ise hamesha pro maana gaya hai kyunke 230V terminal ki garmi ka khatra hai.

title.en: Communication tracking failure after initial power-up
title.ur: Pehli power ke baad communication tracking failure

meaning.en: System could not complete indoor/outdoor address tracking after power-on.
meaning.ur: Power on ke baad system kamre wale aur bahar wale unit ki address tracking mukammal nahi kar saka.

causes.en: Indoor not connected or quantity setting wrong
causes.ur: Indoor connected nahi ya quantity ki setting galat

causes.en: Cable/polarity error on link
causes.ur: Link par cable/polarity ki ghalti

solutions.en: Verify 4-wire link and outdoor indoor-quantity setting
solutions.ur: Char wire ka link verify karein aur bahar wale unit par kamre wale unit ki quantity setting check karein

solutions.en: Re-run tracking after wiring correction
solutions.ur: Wiring theek hone ke baad tracking dobara chalayein

source.title: Samsung split service manual tracking error sections

title.ur: Kamre wale aur bahar wale unit ka communication error (tracking ke baad)

meaning.en: Ongoing communication failure between indoor and outdoor after initial handshake.
meaning.ur: Pehle handshake ke baad kamre wale aur bahar wale unit ke darmiyan communication fail hoti rahi.

causes.en: Link cable fault or interference
causes.ur: Link cable kharab ya us par interference

causes.en: Either unit's communication circuit failed
causes.ur: Kisi bhi unit ka communication circuit kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Check F1/F2 link voltage pulsation at terminal block
solutions.ur: Terminal block par F1/F2 link ki voltage pulsation check karein

solutions.en: Replace link cable or board as diagnosed
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabiq link cable ya board badlein

notes.en: Wired remote numeric 202 on some cassette/ducted ranges.
notes.ur: Kuch cassette/ducted ranges par wired remote '202' dikhata hai.

title.en: Outdoor main ↔ inverter micom communication timeout
title.ur: Outdoor main aur inverter micom ka communication timeout

meaning.en: No valid communication between outdoor main microcontroller and inverter microcontroller (~1 min).
meaning.ur: Outdoor main microcontroller aur inverter microcontroller ke darmiyan koi theek communication nahi (~1 min).

causes.en: Inverter PBA communication wiring fault
causes.ur: Inverter PBA ki communication wiring kharab

causes.en: Inverter board not powered up
causes.ur: Inverter board power nahi par hua

solutions.en: Check inverter PBA connectors and supply LEDs
solutions.ur: Inverter ke PBA connectors aur supply LEDs check karein

solutions.en: Technician replaces/repairs inverter board if dead
solutions.ur: Board dead ho to technician inverter board badle ya marammat kare

meaning.en: Outdoor ambient temperature thermistor open or short.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ambient temperature thermistor khula ya short.

causes.en: Sensor failure on outdoor ambient probe
causes.ur: Outdoor ambient probe ka sensor kharab

causes.en: Rodent/wiring damage at outdoor unit
causes.ur: Outdoor unit par chuha ya wiring ki kharabi

solutions.en: Measure sensor; replace if out of range; repair harness
solutions.ur: Sensor ko naap lein; range se bahar ho to badlein aur harness ki marammat karein

solutions.en: Restore power after repair and confirm code clears
solutions.ur: Marammat ke baad power wapas laayein aur code hatne ki tasdeeq karein

meaning.en: Condenser outlet (COND OUT) pipe sensor open or short.
meaning.ur: Condenser outlet (COND OUT) pipe sensor khula ya short.

causes.en: COND-OUT thermistor failed
causes.ur: COND-OUT thermistor kharab

causes.en: Connector corrosion at outdoor board
causes.ur: Outdoor board par connector mein zang

solutions.en: Isolate power to the outdoor unit at the breaker before touching the sensor or its wiring.
solutions.ur: Sensor ya uski wiring chhoone se pehle breaker par outdoor unit ka power band kar dein.

solutions.en: Find the COND-OUT pipe sensor on the condenser outlet, unplug it and measure its resistance with a meter at room temperature; an open circuit or a reading far off the normal curve confirms a failed sensor, so replace it.
solutions.ur: Condenser outlet par COND-OUT pipe sensor dhoondein, usse nikal kar room temperature par meter se resistance nap lein; circuit khula ho ya reading normal curve se bahar ho to sensor fail ho chuka hai, ise badal dein.

solutions.en: If the sensor measures normal, clean corrosion from the connector at the outdoor board, reseat it and retest; replace the harness if the reading is still open or short.
solutions.ur: Agar sensor normal nap jaye to outdoor board ke connector se zang saaf karein, phir lagayein aur phir test karein; reading phir bhi open ya short ho to harness badal dein.

notes.en: Some tables label E237 as cond sensor open/short — generation-dependent numbering.
notes.ur: Kuch tables E237 ko cond sensor open/short ke tor par label karti hain — numbering generation par depend karti hai.

meaning.en: Discharge (DIS-TH) temperature sensor open or short on the outdoor unit.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit par discharge (DIS-TH) temperature sensor khula ya short.

causes.en: Discharge sensor failure
causes.ur: Discharge sensor kharab

causes.en: Sensor not inserted fully in well / wiring open
causes.ur: Sensor well mein poori tarah baitha nahi ya wiring khuli

solutions.en: Reseat sensor in well; measure and replace if bad
solutions.ur: Sensor ko well mein dobara baithayein; naap kar kharab ho to badlein

solutions.en: Do not run compressor long with invalid discharge reading
solutions.ur: Galat discharge reading ke saath compressor zyada der na chalayein

meaning.en: Compressor overload protector (OLP) sensor input out of range.
meaning.ur: Compressor overload protector (OLP) ka sensor input range se bahar.

causes.en: OLP sensor or wiring fault
causes.ur: OLP sensor ya wiring kharabi

causes.en: Compressor overload condition related
causes.ur: Compressor overload ki halat se mutaalliq

solutions.en: Check OLP sensor circuit per service procedure
solutions.ur: Service procedure ke mutabiq OLP sensor circuit check karein

solutions.en: Confirm compressor current/overload before resetting
solutions.ur: Reset se pehle compressor current/overload ki tasdeeq karein

notes.en: Some regional tables number this E320; wired remote '320'.
notes.ur: Kuch regional tables mein yeh code E320 hai; wired remote par '320' nazar aata hai.

title.ur: Discharge zyada garmi ki hifazat (comp band)

meaning.en: Compressor stopped because discharge temperature exceeded the safety limit.
meaning.ur: Discharge temperature safety limit se aipar chali gayi, is liye compressor band ho gaya.

causes.en: Low refrigerant / leak reducing heat rejection
causes.ur: Refrigerant kam ya leak ki wajah se heat rejection kam ho rahi hai

causes.en: Blocked condenser airflow or failing discharge sensor reading high
causes.ur: Condenser ka airflow band ya discharge sensor zyada parh raha hai

solutions.en: Clear debris around outdoor coil (power off) and clean filters; restart once
solutions.ur: Power band rakh kar outdoor coil ke aas paas ki miley saaf karein aur filters saaf karein; ek baar restart karein

solutions.en: If code returns, licensed tech leak-tests and checks charge
solutions.ur: Agar code wapas aaye to licensed technician leak test kare aur charge check kare

source.title: Samsung AC200KNHPKH service manual E416 section

notes.en: Critical PK summer code — dirty coils + low gas common.
notes.ur: PK garmiyon mein aham code — gande coils aur kam gas aam wajuhat hain.

title.ur: EEV / valve band hone ka error (khud diagnosis)

meaning.en: Electronic expansion valve failed to close as expected (or pipe-blocking related valve error).
meaning.ur: Electronic expansion valve jis tarah band hona chahiye tha us par band nahi hua (ya pipe blocking ki wajah se aaya valve error).

causes.en: EEV coil/wiring fault
causes.ur: EEV coil ya wiring kharab

causes.en: Valve stuck / new-install valve not opened
causes.ur: Valve phans hua hai ya nayi installation mein valve khul nahi raha

causes.en: System blockage affecting valve behavior
causes.ur: System mein rakaot jo valve ke amal par asar daalta hai

solutions.en: On new installs, verify service valves opened correctly
solutions.ur: Nayi installation par service valves ke khulne ki tasdeeq karein

solutions.en: On old units, tech checks gas leak/blockage and EEV drive
solutions.ur: Purany units par technician gas leak/rakaot aur EEV drive check kare

notes.en: Primax technician notes also link E422 to gas issues on older units.
notes.ur: Primax technician notes E422 ko purani units ke gas maslon se bhi jorte hain.

meaning.en: Heating operation restricted because outdoor temperature is too high (>30°C class limit).
meaning.ur: Heating chalti nahi, kyun ke outdoor temperature zyada hai (>30°C class ki limit se aipar).

causes.en: Attempting heat mode in hot weather
causes.ur: Garmi ke mausam mein heat mode chalane ki koshish

causes.en: Outdoor temperature sensor reading high incorrectly
causes.ur: Outdoor temperature sensor galat tor par zyada parh raha hai

solutions.en: Switch to Cool/Fan; this is a operating-limit, not a part failure
solutions.ur: Cool/Fan par jayen; yeh operating limit hai, kisi part ki kharabi nahi

solutions.en: If it appears in winter, technician checks OUT-TH sensor
solutions.ur: Agar sardi mein aaye to technician OUT-TH sensor check kare

notes.en: is_fault true because it is in the fault table, but severity info/self-limiting.
notes.ur: Fault table mein hone ki wajah se is_fault true rakha gaya hai, magar severity info/self-limiting hai.

meaning.en: Cooling operation restricted because outdoor temperature is below the allowed limit.
meaning.ur: Cooling chalti nahi, kyun ke outdoor temperature ijazat ki limit se neeche hai.

causes.en: Cooling started in very cold ambient
causes.ur: Bahut thand mein cooling shuru ho gayi

causes.en: Outdoor sensor reading too low incorrectly
causes.ur: Outdoor sensor galat tor par kam parh raha hai

solutions.en: Avoid cooling below the manual's minimum ambient
solutions.ur: Manual ki kam az kam ambient temperature se neeche cooling na karein

solutions.en: Technician verifies outdoor sensor if unexpected
solutions.ur: Agar ghair maujuda ho to technician outdoor sensor verify kare

aliases: C203 (related outdoor fan slot on some C-tables — verify)

meaning.en: Outdoor fan motor not running correctly / feedback missing.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan motor theek nahi chal raha / feedback nahi aa raha.

causes.en: Outdoor fan motor failure or blade obstruction
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor kharab ya blade mein rok

causes.en: Fan wiring / outdoor PCB drive fault
causes.ur: Fan wiring ya outdoor PCB drive kharabi

solutions.en: Power off; clear debris around fan; check for free blade rotation
solutions.ur: Power band karein; fan ke aas paas moqa saaf karein; blade ki aazadi check karein

solutions.en: Technician tests motor and replaces if locked
solutions.ur: Technician motor test kare aur jam ho to badle de

notes.en: Outdoor PCB LED red/green/yellow patterns accompany this on non-display outdoor boards.
notes.ur: Non-display outdoor boards par outdoor PCB ke red/green/yellow LED pattern iske sath nazar aate hain.

meaning.en: Inverter failed to start the compressor within allowed attempts.
meaning.ur: Inverter ijazat ki koshishon mein compressor start nahi kar saka.

causes.en: Weak/incorrect supply voltage or wiring to compressor
causes.ur: Compressor ko kamzor/ghalat supply ya wiring

causes.en: Stuck compressor or inverter module problem
causes.ur: Compressor jam gaya hua ya inverter module mein masla

solutions.en: Check mains voltage under load and compressor leads
solutions.ur: Mains voltage ko load ke under check karein aur compressor ke leads dekhein

solutions.en: Licensed tech tests inverter module and compressor
solutions.ur: Licensed technician inverter module aur compressor test kare

notes.en: PK voltage-fluctuation environments make this and E466/E483 frequent.
notes.ur: PK mein voltage fluctuation ki wajah se yeh code aur E466/E483 aksar aate hain.

title.en: AC input current limit trip / primary current trip
title.ur: AC input ka current limit trip / primary current trip

meaning.en: Input current exceeded the allowed limit and the unit tripped.
meaning.ur: Input current ijazat ki limit se zyada ho gaya aur unit trip ho gayi.

causes.en: Compressor overload drawing high current
causes.ur: Compressor overload ki wajah se zyada current kheench raha hai

causes.en: PFC/rectifier fault or supply issue
causes.ur: PFC/rectifier kharab ya supply ka masla

solutions.en: Check supply voltage and outdoor fan operation
solutions.ur: Supply voltage aur outdoor fan ka kaam check karein

solutions.en: Technician measures running current and inspects inverter PBA
solutions.ur: Technician chalte waqt ka current napti hai aur inverter PBA ka jaiza leta hai

meaning.en: Inverter power module tripped on over-current.
meaning.ur: Over-current par inverter power module trip ho gaya.

causes.en: Short/stress on IPM or motor windings
causes.ur: IPM ya motor windings par short/stress

causes.en: Compressor winding fault
causes.ur: Compressor ki winding kharab

solutions.en: Do not keep resetting; stop and schedule service
solutions.ur: bar bar ry syt nh kary yont bnd kar ke sros lgayy

solutions.en: Licensed tech tests module, compressor and drive
solutions.ur: Licensed technician module, compressor aur drive test kare

meaning.en: Compressor voltage/current limit exceeded (overload stop).
meaning.ur: Compressor ka voltage/current limit zyada ho gaya (overload rok).

causes.en: Sustained overload (high ambient, low gas, dirty coil)
causes.ur: Lagaatar overload (zyada garmi, kam gas, ganda coil)

causes.en: Inverter limit settings/board fault
causes.ur: Inverter limit settings ya board kharabi

solutions.en: Restore airflow (clean coil/filters); check charge if needed
solutions.ur: Airflow wapas laayein (coil/filters saaf karein); zaroorat ho to charge check karein

solutions.en: Technician evaluates compressor and inverter
solutions.ur: Technician compressor aur inverter ka jaiza leta hai

meaning.en: DC bus voltage left the safe window (commonly <150V or >410V).
meaning.ur: DC bus voltage mehfoz range se bahar chala gaya (aksar <150V ya >410V).

causes.en: Mains brownouts / overvoltage (common in PK load-shedding)
causes.ur: Mains mein brownout ya overvoltage (PK load-shedding mein aam hai)

causes.en: Rectifier/bleeder capacitor fault
causes.ur: Rectifier/bleeder capacitor kharab

solutions.en: Verify supply with meter; use quality stabilizer if swings are large
solutions.ur: Supply ko meter se check karein; swings zyada hon to achi stabilizer lagayein

solutions.en: Technician checks DC-link components if voltage is normal
solutions.ur: Voltage aam ho to technician DC-link ke ajza check kare

title.ur: Compressor ki wire ghayab / rotation ki kharabi

meaning.en: One or more compressor leads missing or compressor rotation feedback wrong.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki aik ya zyada leads ghayab hain ya compressor rotation feedback ghalat hai.

causes.en: Loose/burnt compressor terminal wire
causes.ur: Compressor terminal ki wire khuli ya jli hui

causes.en: Inverter drive phase issue
causes.ur: Inverter drive phase ka masla

solutions.en: Power off; inspect compressor terminals and harness
solutions.ur: Power band karein; compressor terminals aur harness dekhein

solutions.en: Replace damaged leads; tech retests start cycle
solutions.ur: Kharab leads badlein; technician start cycle dobara test kare

meaning.en: Current sensing on the inverter PBA is invalid.
meaning.ur: Inverter PBA par current sensing ki reading ghalat hai.

causes.en: Current sensor/CT fault on inverter board
causes.ur: Inverter board par current sensor/CT kharabi

causes.en: Board damage after surge
causes.ur: Board surge se kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Stop use; technician tests/ replaces inverter PBA
solutions.ur: Istemal band karein; technician inverter PBA test/badal kare

solutions.en: Check history of voltage spikes in the premises
solutions.ur: Premises mein voltage spikes ki purani tareekh dekhein

notes.en: BK channel hashtags also mention Samsung E468 (corroboration only).
notes.ur: BK channel ke hashtags mein Samsung E468 ka zikr bhi hai (sirf confirm karne ke liye).

meaning.en: The board cannot trust its DC-link voltage measurement.
meaning.ur: Board apni DC-link voltage par bharosa nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Voltage divider/sensor circuit fault
causes.ur: Voltage divider/sensor ki circuit kharabi ho gayi

causes.en: PCB contamination or damage
causes.ur: PCB par mitti phaili hui ya kharabi

solutions.en: Leave unit off; technician measures sensor circuit
solutions.ur: Unit ko band rakhein; technician sensor circuit nape

solutions.en: Board repair/replacement as indicated
solutions.ur: Hisaab ke mutabiq board ki marammat ya replacement

meaning.en: Outdoor controller memory has no/invalid data.
meaning.ur: Outdoor controller ki memory mein koi data nahi ya invalid data hai.

causes.en: EEPROM blank or corrupted after power event
causes.ur: Power event ke baad EEPROM khali ya kharab

causes.en: Failed EEPROM chip
causes.ur: EEPROM chip kharab

solutions.en: Power the unit off and keep it off; do not keep resetting, because repeated power events can corrupt the outdoor EEPROM data further.
solutions.ur: Unit ka power band kar ke rakhein; baar baar reset na karein, kyunke baar baar power cuts se outdoor EEPROM data aur kharab ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: A technician rewrites the outdoor option data with the service tool, then power cycles the unit and checks that the code clears.
solutions.ur: Technician service tool se outdoor option data dobara likhe, uske baad unit ka power cycle karke check kare ke code chala gaya.

solutions.en: If the rewrite fails or the code comes back straight away, replace the EEPROM chip or the outdoor control board.
solutions.ur: Agar dobara write fail ho ya code foran wapas aaye to EEPROM chip ya outdoor control board badal dein.

title.en: Inverter EEPROM read/write error (main ↔ inv micom)
title.ur: Inverter EEPROM read/write ka error (main ↔ inv micom)

meaning.en: Main and inverter microcontrollers disagree on EEPROM contents.
meaning.ur: Main aur inverter microcontrollers ka EEPROM data aapas mein match nahi karta.

causes.en: One side's EEPROM data corrupted
causes.ur: Kisi ek taraf ka EEPROM data kharab

causes.en: Communication glitch during data exchange
causes.ur: Data badalne ke doran communication mein kharabi

solutions.en: Power-cycle; technician syncs/rewrites EEPROM on both boards
solutions.ur: Power cycle karein; technician dono boards par EEPROM ko sync/rewrite kare

solutions.en: Replace failed board if data will not persist
solutions.ur: Data theek na rahe to kharab board badlein

meaning.en: Heatsink temperature reading on inverter PBA is invalid (or over-temp depending on generation).
meaning.ur: Inverter PBA par heatsink temperature ki reading ghalat hai (ya generation ke mutabiq zyada garmi).

causes.en: Heatsink sensor open/short
causes.ur: Heatsink sensor khula/short

causes.en: Blocked outdoor airflow causing real overheat
causes.ur: Outdoor airflow band hone se asli overheat ho gaya

solutions.en: Clear outdoor airflow; let unit cool; reset once
solutions.ur: Outdoor airflow saaf karein; unit thanda hone dein; ek baar reset karein

solutions.en: Technician replaces sensor or inverter PBA
solutions.ur: Technician sensor ya inverter PBA badle

notes.en: Generation note: some tables map heatsink-over-temp to E474/E500 differently.
notes.ur: Generation note: kuch tables heatsink-over-temp ko E474/E500 par alag-alag map karti hain.

meaning.en: Power-factor-correction stage overloaded and shut down.
meaning.ur: Power-factor-correction stage overloaded ho kar band ho gaya.

causes.en: Mains instability or PFC component failure
causes.ur: Mains mein instability ya PFC ke component ki kharabi

causes.en: Heavy current draw at compressor start
causes.ur: Compressor start par zyada current

solutions.en: Check supply quality; tech inspects PFC section
solutions.ur: Supply ki quality check karein; technician PFC section ka jaiza leta hai

solutions.en: Repair/replace inverter PBA as needed
solutions.ur: Zarurat ke mutabiq inverter PBA ki marammat ya tabdeeli karein

title.en: AC input voltage sensor / I-limit trip
title.ur: AC input ka voltage sensor / I-limit trip

meaning.en: AC input voltage sensing out of range or input current-limit trip.
meaning.ur: AC input voltage ki reading range se bahar ya input current-limit trip.

causes.en: Actual mains out of window (PK brownouts/spikes)
causes.ur: Asal mains range se bahar (PK brownouts/spikes)

causes.en: Voltage sensor circuit fault
causes.ur: Voltage sensor ki circuit kharabi

solutions.en: Measure mains; correct supply issues first
solutions.ur: Mains napein; pehle supply ke masle theek karein

solutions.en: Technician tests sensor circuit if mains OK
solutions.ur: Mains theek ho to technician sensor circuit test kare

meaning.en: Inverter module heatsink exceeded safe temperature and the unit shut down.
meaning.ur: Inverter module ka heatsink mehfoz temperature se upar chala gaya aur unit band ho gayi.

causes.en: Poor outdoor airflow / fan not running
causes.ur: Outdoor airflow kamzor / fan nahi chal raha

causes.en: Failing heatsink fan path or heavy load in extreme heat
causes.ur: Heatsink fan ka rasta kharab ya bohat garmi mein zyada load

solutions.en: Power off; clean outdoor unit; verify outdoor fan works
solutions.ur: Power band karein; outdoor unit saaf karein; outdoor fan ka kaam check karein

solutions.en: Let cool before one restart; tech checks module if repeat
solutions.ur: Ek baar restart se pehle thanda hone dein; dobara ho to tech module check kare

meaning.en: The system detected refrigerant leakage (single/dual detection) and stops operation.
meaning.ur: System ne refrigerant leak dekh liya (aik ya do baar) aur chalti band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Actual refrigerant leak at flare/joints/indoor coil
causes.ur: Flare/joints/indoor coil par asal refrigerant ka leak

causes.en: Sensor/board false detection (less common)
causes.ur: Sensor/board ki ghalt detection (kam common)

solutions.en: Stop the unit; ventilate; no open flames (R32/R410A)
solutions.ur: Unit band karein; ventilate karein; khuli aag se parhez (R32/R410A)

solutions.en: Licensed technician leak-tests, repairs, then re-gasses to spec
solutions.ur: Licensed technician leak test kare, marammat kare, phir specification ke mutabiq gas bhar dein

notes.en: Samsung India video also advises EC-style gas/sensor message: power off/on once, then service.
notes.ur: Samsung India ki video mein bhi EC-style gas/sensor message ki salah di gayi hai: ek baar power off/on karein, uske baad service.

title.ur: Kamre wale/bahar wale unit ki capacity mein mismatch

meaning.en: The rated capacity or option code stored on the indoor unit does not match the outdoor unit, so the pair cannot run.
meaning.ur: Kamre wale unit par mojood rated capacity ya option code bahar wale unit se match nahi karta, is liye dono ek saath nahi chal sakte.

causes.en: Indoor and outdoor units of different capacities paired at installation
causes.ur: Installation ke waqt alag alag capacity ke indoor aur outdoor units aapas mein jor diye gaye

causes.en: Capacity/option code written to the board after a PCB swap is wrong
causes.ur: PCB ki jagah nayi board lagne par capacity/option code ghalat likha gaya

solutions.en: Verify model plates of indoor and outdoor units are a matched pair
solutions.ur: Kamre wale aur bahar wale units ke model plates ka pair (jorra) match ho, verify karein

solutions.en: Technician rewrites the correct capacity/option code or fits the correct unit
solutions.ur: Technician sahi capacity/option code dobara likhe ya sahi unit fit kare

source.title: Samsung split service manual self-diagnostic table (E556 capacity/option mismatch)

notes.en: Common after mismatched pair installation or indoor PCB replacement without code rewrite.
notes.ur: Ghalat pair installation ya code rewrite kiye baghair indoor PCB badalne ke baad aam milta hai.
